name: Ruff
title: Lint and format-check real Python projects with Ruff
job: Projects lint and format-check their original configured trees with Ruff in CI. Each project operation runs 14 cold Ruff processes on a fresh project copy: the original `ruff check`, `ruff check --select ALL --statistics` in stable and `--preview` modes for target versions py39 through py314, and `ruff format --check`, with eight Rayon threads and cache and fixes disabled.
operations: pandas: original pre-commit-selected paths split into disjoint CLI batches
FastAPI: check fastapi tests docs_src scripts
editable: Only allowlisted Rust production files within the twenty source roots in release.json. Original inline-test tails and documentation comments remain byte-identical. Tests, manifests, dependencies, generated code, build settings, driver, inputs and project trees are protected.

families.options: Original pandas force-exclude and exit-non-zero-on-fix flags; JSON diagnostics; fixes and persistent cache disabled

size_meaning: Original project file inventory and frozen selected path batches.
variables: Project configuration and selected lint rules
options: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=8; --no-cache --no-fix --output-format=json; unchanged upstream release profile (fat LTO).
outputs: Per project, cli-output-v1 JSON containing every batch's exit code and complete stdout/stderr bytes encoded in base64; length and SHA-256 must equal the pinned baseline.
contract: Byte-identical cli-output-v1 per project, unchanged supported CLI/API behavior and upstream baseline test outcomes. No input detection, hidden delegation, persistent caches, changed commands or arguments, or surviving helper processes.
limits: Linux amd64, pinned Rust 1.99.0 and source-built Ruff 0.16.10. Clean public projects do not prove correctness on diagnostic-producing code; held-out and mutation controls are required.
preparation: SHA-256-pinned Ruff and Rust archives, Cargo.lock-verified vendored dependencies, complete original Git trees checked against blob/file inventories, committed source checkout and prebuilt offline baseline.
input_edition_note: Each of the four cases (pandas and FastAPI public; HTTPX and Rich held-out) runs its original `ruff check` plus a CI-style matrix (`ruff check --select ALL --statistics`, stable and `--preview`, target versions py39 through py314) and `ruff format --check`, so every timed unit lasts about a second or more. Projects, file inventories and the original command are unchanged; expected outputs were generated with the pristine Ruff build.
